notes.title: Rated 8/10 on SpelStation.se!
notes.content:
SpelStation had these comments about the game: 

- "Whacking Hell!" has one of the most interesting visual styles I've seen in the genre.

- The game has great, powerful gothic music with organ, violin and heavy electro beats. It keeps the rounds fresh and I wouldn't mind getting the soundtrack on vinyl.

- "Whacking Hell!" quickly became one of my favorite games in the genre with its mix of Darkest Dungeon and Vampire Survivors pushing the player into this “one more round” mindset.

Link to the review: https://www.spelstation.se/recension/whacking-hell/
